retrievalProfile.description: A centered circular mascot emblem featuring a characterful bulldog with psychedelic, arched bubble lettering above it on a flat cream background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central red circular medallion containing a stylized, cartoonish bulldog head wearing a bowler hat and smoking a cigar, set against a pale yellow/cream square background with arched, thick-stroked psychedelic text at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Arched text follows the upper curve of the central circle
Mascot character is contained within a high-contrast circular frame
Thick black outlines unify the character and the typography
Flat color fields create a screen-printed vintage aesthetic
coreInvariants: Heavy black outlines on all graphic elements
Arched orientation of the primary display text
Circular framing device for the central subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The bulldog mascot is centered within a large red circle that occupies the middle 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The red circular medallion serves as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the vibrant red circle, moves up to the arched text, and then settles on the character details like the hat and cigar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample flat cream-colored negative space surrounds the central circular composition.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bold Red for the circular emblem
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Black for outlines and character details
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the central red circle against a low-saturation, high-value background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold sans-serif with liquid, organic curves
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are distorted to fit a radial arch
Internal holes (counters) are reduced to small teardrop shapes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Standalone display lettering; no secondary text is used to maintain focus on the graphic mark.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a flat cream background with a large centered red circle. Inside the circle, place a cartoon bulldog head with a bowler hat and cigar in a 1940s-animation style with thick black outlines.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom arched bubble lettering above the circle, using a red fill and a thick black outline to match the illustration style.

verificationChecks: Is the text arched following the circle?
Are the outlines thick and consistent?
Is the background a flat, solid cream color?
Does the bulldog have a bowler hat and cigar?

mustAchieve: Cohesive outline weight between text and image

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible despite the psychedelic distortion
Check that the red of the text matches the red of the circle
Verify the character's expression is consistent with a vintage mascot
Confirm the composition is perfectly centered
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage Mascot + Psychedelic Arched Bubble Type + Circular Frame + Flat Color Palette
